comments.author: dkarl
comments.why: Pepin says nonstick is ideal for omelets
comments.text: The pilot episode of The French Chef, Julia Child's show, in 1962 was making an omelette with butter in a steel pan. But why not use non-stick? After that original 1962 show, she uses a nonstick pan in all the other videos I've seen. I think we have a tendency to assume the hard way produces the best results, but in this case I don't think there's any reason to think so. Julia Child 1962, steel (PBS paywall): [LINK] Julia Child 1980, nonstick (she specifically says you should use a nonstick pan): [LINK] Jacques Pepin, nonstick (says nonstick is "ideal") : [VIDEO]
